g.text: Where realized outcomes allow a profitable unilateral switch
Own-payoff presentation · R=1, P=0 · two label blocks · up to 2 games/cell
White = zero gap; darker red = larger gap; gray = no usable data; dot = reduced count. Dashed: regime boundaries.
Realized regret holds the opponent’s action fixed. Positive regret can occur under valid mixed-equilibrium play.
